notice.title: Beneficial ownership for business customers
notice.aiSummary: Banks must identify and verify individuals owning 25% or more of business customers before opening accounts, and refresh this information annually for high-risk business customers. Compliance is required by January 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to banks that open accounts for companies, partnerships and other legal entities, and Brivanta Bank offers small business loans and deposit accounts.

text:
ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING DIRECTORATE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Guidance: Beneficial ownership for business customers
Notice number: RCN-2026-005
Issued by: Anti-Money Laundering Directorate
Published: 2026-09-08
Effective date: 2027-01-01
1. Who this applies to
Banks that open accounts for companies, partnerships and other legal entities.
2. Background
Criminals continue to hide behind layers of company ownership. The Directorate expects firms to know who ultimately owns and controls their business customers.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must identify and verify every individual who owns 25 percent or more of a business customer before opening the account.
3.2 A firm must refresh beneficial ownership information for high-risk business customers at least once a year.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-01-01.

obligations.text: A firm must identify and verify every individual who owns 25 percent or more of a business customer before opening the account.
obligations.controlDesc: Account opening system blocks business accounts until owners of 25 percent or more are verified
obligations.reason: Policy POL-AML-01 states "For business customers, every individual owning 25 percent or more is identified and verified before account opening" and Control CTL-161 blocks business accounts until owners of 25 percent or more are verified, which exactly matches the obligation's threshold and timing requirement.

obligations.text: A firm must refresh beneficial ownership information for high-risk business customers at least once a year.
obligations.controlDesc: Monthly report of high-risk business customers whose beneficial ownership refresh is overdue
obligations.reason: Policy POL-AML-01 states "Beneficial ownership for high-risk business customers is refreshed every year" which exactly matches the obligation's requirement of at least once a year, and CTL-162's monthly monitoring of overdue refreshes would detect breaches of this specific obligation.
